15:91.text: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.

15:92.text: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

15:93.text: About what they used to do.

15:94.text: Then declare what you are commanded
and turn away from the polytheists.

15:95.text: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

15:96.text: with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.

15:97.text: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

15:98.text: with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate

15:99.text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty

16:1.text: The command of Allāh is coming,
so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

16:2.text: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration
of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants,
, "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."

16:3.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.

16:4.text: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once

16:5.text: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth
benefits, and from them you eat.

16:6.text: And for you in them is
beauty when you bring them in
and when you send them out
